description: This file declares the private implementation class for the OpenCDMSystem, including its interface, member variables, and related functions. It also declares a factory function for creating system instances. The file is part of a media or DRM system, with references to message dispatching, backend control, and session management.

classes.name: OpenCDMSystemPrivate
classes.description: A private implementation of the OpenCDMSystem interface, managing DRM system details, sessions, and storage.

methods.name: OpenCDMSystemPrivate(const std::string &system, const std::string &metadata, const std::shared_ptr<MessageDispatcher> &messageDispatcher, const std::shared_ptr<CdmBackend> &cdmBackend)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DRM system with system info, metadata, message dispatcher, and backend control.

methods.name: metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the DRM system.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified license type, callbacks, init data, and data type.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit on LDL sessions.

methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.
